sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Dear Kenny,

Hi! I saw your name and address in the *Students' Post*, and I would like to be your friend. My name is Sun Kai. I live in Shenyang. I am in Grade 7. I have short black hair. I don't like table tennis and I'm not interested in rugby. My favourite sport is football. I want to be a football player.

My father is an engineer and my mother is a shop assistant. They are very kind. I have a sister. She is eight and she is a student, too. She is at primary school. She likes reading and she is very clever. I love my family very much.

Here is a photo of my family and myself. Tell me something about your family. Write to me soon.

Best wishes,
Sun Kai

questions.prompt: 1. What is Sun Kai interested in?
questions.translation: 孙凯对什么感兴趣？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“My favourite sport is football. I want to be a football player.”可知孙凯对足球感兴趣。故选 Football.。

questions.prompt: 2. What is Sun Kai's mother's job?
questions.translation: 孙凯妈妈的职业是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“My father is an engineer and my mother is a shop assistant.”可知妈妈是售货员。故选 She is a shop assistant.。

questions.prompt: 3. How many people are there in Sun Kai's family?
questions.translation: 孙凯家有几口人？
questions.explanation: 文中提到了爸爸、妈妈、妹妹以及孙凯自己，共4人。故选 Four.。

questions.prompt: 4. What is the text above?
questions.translation: 上面的文本是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章格式“Dear Kenny,... Best wishes, Sun Kai”可知这是一封信。故选 A letter.。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Eliza Smith walks along a road on St. John in the US. There, her family is taking a vacation. She asks her mom to give the next clue(线索).

Looking at the piece of paper in her hand, her mom reads out loud, “Walk along the road. Pass the apple tree on your right, get to the high ground and find the cacao tree."

After a few minutes, they're in front of the cacao tree and reading the last of the clues, "Keep your back to the tree and take four steps off the road."

After taking four steps, Eliza looks down at an old stone wall. Digging in carefully, she calls out, "There it is!" It is a plastic box in a plastic bag.

The Smiths are letterboxing, a fun outdoor activity that sends people to different places to look for letterboxes. "Letterbox" is the word used for a mailbox in England. The letterboxing game probably first started in the 1850s, when an Englishman left cards in a bottle with a note. He invited others to do the same. Soon people began leaving messages or letters for other people to find. Now letterboxes are not bottles but plastic boxes.

questions.prompt: 5. What are the Smiths doing?
questions.translation: 史密斯一家在做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“The Smiths are letterboxing, a fun outdoor activity... The letterboxing game probably first started...”可知他们在玩寻宝信箱游戏。故选 Playing a game.。

questions.prompt: 6. When does the family read the last clue?
options: After finding the old stone wall.
When standing in front of the cacao tree.
When taking four steps off the road.
questions.translation: 这家人什么时候读最后一条线索？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“they're in front of the cacao tree and reading the last of the clues...”可知是在可可树前。故选 When standing in front of the cacao tree.。

questions.prompt: 7. Where does Eliza find the plastic box in the end?
questions.translation: 伊莱扎最终在哪里找到了塑料盒子？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“Eliza looks down at an old stone wall. Digging in carefully, she calls out, 'There it is!'”可知是在古老的石墙里。故选 In the old stone wall.。

questions.prompt: 8. Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: The Smiths are on holiday on St. John in the US.
People do letterboxing inside their houses.
An American started the letterboxing game in the 1850s.
People will take away the boxes that they find in the game.
questions.translation: 根据文章，下列哪项陈述是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Eliza Smith walks along a road on St. John in the US. There, her family is taking a vacation.”可知史密斯一家在美国圣约翰度假。故选 The Smiths are on holiday on St. John in the US.。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Evan, an orange and white fox, has a farm. It's Evan's home. His friend, a black and white dog, often stays there with him and they do everything together. They drive Evan's farm truck and play games. They read books and have ice cream. But their favourite thing is working in Evan's yard. In the yard, plants are big and beautiful. But friends don't always stay together. One day, the dog dies, so Evan loses his best friend. Without his best friend, the yard becomes a sad place. Evan feels so angry that he destroys(破坏) his yard.

But a good place will not stay empty for long. New plants quietly start to grow. One day, Evan finds a small pumpkin(南瓜) vine in his yard. He starts to look after it. Fall comes and there is a huge pumpkin on the vine in his yard.

It is the fair (集市) week. Evan takes his huge pumpkin to the fair. He meets his old friends there and he enjoys delicious food. Best of all, his pumpkin wins him a prize: 10 dollars or a little dog. What does Evan want? You might know the answer. Yes. He drives home with the dog.

**Do you know?**
This is the story of the book *The Rough Patch*(《粗糙补丁》). It is a 2018 picture book by the USA writer Brian Lies. The book won the 2019 Caldecott Medal (凯迪克大奖).

questions.prompt: 9. Where do Evan and the dog like to stay best?
questions.translation: 埃文和小狗最喜欢待在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“But their favourite thing is working in Evan's yard.”可知是在院子里。故选 In the yard.。

questions.prompt: 10. What does Evan do after his friend dies?
options: He grows many plants in his yard.
He makes lots of new friends on his farm.
He doesn't work in his yard for some time.
questions.translation: 埃文在朋友死后做了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Evan feels so angry that he destroys his yard... Without his best friend, the yard becomes a sad place.”可知他破坏了院子并有一段时间不再打理院子。故选 He doesn't work in his yard for some time.。

questions.prompt: 11. What do you know from the second paragraph?
options: Evan is angry to see some new plants.
Evan likes the small pumpkin vine.
Evan is worried that pumpkins can't grow in his yard.
In fall, Evan finds a small pumpkin vine in his yard.
questions.translation: 你从第二段中了解到了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“One day, Evan finds a small pumpkin vine in his yard. He starts to look after it.”可知Evan喜欢这根小南瓜藤并悉心照料它。故选 Evan likes the small pumpkin vine.。

questions.prompt: 12. The purpose (目的) of the passage is to ________
options: ask us to make friends with dogs
tell us about the Caldecott Medal
tell us about a picture book
ask us to read picture books
questions.translation: 这篇文章的目的是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据末尾“This is the story of the book The Rough Patch...”可知本文是为了介绍这本获奖绘本的故事。故选 tell us about a picture book。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Most people enjoy hiking. Hiking is not only a healthy but also a relaxing activity. Why do people like to go hiking? The answers are different. Here are some of the most popular reasons(原因).

First of all, hiking is good exercise. It can make your body strong and make you become smart.

Secondly, hiking is simple and cheap. All you need is to wear a pair of hiking shoes and take your smile to start.

Also, it is a good way to learn new things during the hiking. Maybe you can never know them in your classes.

Finally, hiking is the best way to get away from your everyday life. You can hike alone or go with your friends. After hiking, you may have a clear mind. So why not plan your hiking route(路线) now?

questions.prompt: 13. Hiking can make us ________
questions.translation: 徒步旅行能使我们放松。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Hiking is not only a healthy but also a relaxing activity.”可知徒步使人放松。故选 relaxed。

questions.prompt: 14. What do you need to wear for the hiking?
questions.translation: 去徒步旅行你需要穿什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“All you need is to wear a pair of hiking shoes...”可知需要穿一双登山鞋。故选 A pair of hiking shoes.。

questions.prompt: 15. What does the passage mainly talk about?
options: How to plan a hiking trip.
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲述了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Why do people like to go hiking? The answers are different. Here are some of the most popular reasons.”可知文章主要讲人们喜欢徒步的原因。故选 Why people like hiking.。

questions.prompt: 16. Which of the following is the structure (结构) of the passage?
questions.translation: 下列哪一个是文章的段落结构？
questions.explanation: 第一段总起提问并引出原因，第二、三、四、五段分别以 First of all, Secondly, Also, Finally 并列陈述四点原因，属于总分结构（① / ② ③ ④ ⑤）。故选 A。

sections.title: 五、阅读理解 第二节
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文, 从方框所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项, 其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Welcome to Beijing! I'm happy to be your guide. 17. ________ Beijing is the capital of China with many places of interest.

The first day, we are going to visit Tian'anmen Square, the Palace Museum and the Temple of Heaven. They are in the centre of the city. 18. ________

The second day, we are going to the Great Wall and the Ming Tombs by bus. 19. ________ So the trip will take about two hours.

The last day, we'll visit the Summer Palace and the Fragrant Hills(香山). They are in the countryside, and we'll go there by bus. 20. ________ It'll be very interesting.

These places are good for travelling. I'm sure you will enjoy yourselves.

> A. It's just half an hour's bus ride.
> B. They are very far from the city.
> C. So we are just walking there.
> D. We all like it.
> E. I will visit this great city with you.

options: It's just half an hour's bus ride.
They are very far from the city.
So we are just walking there.
I will visit this great city with you.
questions.translation: 我将和你们一起游览这座伟大的城市。
questions.explanation: 承接前句导游的开场白“I'm happy to be your guide.”，引出与大家一起游览北京。故选 E (I will visit this great city with you.)。

options: It's just half an hour's bus ride.
They are very far from the city.
So we are just walking there.
I will visit this great city with you.
questions.translation: 所以我们直接步行去那里。
questions.explanation: 前句提到“They are in the centre of the city.”（景点都在市中心），因此步行即可到达。故选 C (So we are just walking there.)。

options: It's just half an hour's bus ride.
They are very far from the city.
So we are just walking there.
I will visit this great city with you.
questions.translation: 它们距离市区非常远。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着说明“So the trip will take about two hours.”（坐车需要两小时），说明景点离市区远。故选 B (They are very far from the city.)。

options: It's just half an hour's bus ride.
They are very far from the city.
So we are just walking there.
I will visit this great city with you.
questions.translation: 坐公交只要半小时车程。
questions.explanation: 承接去颐和园和香山的交通方式，说明乘车时间。故选 A (It's just half an hour's bus ride.)。

sections.title: 六、完形填空
sections.instruction: 二、完形填空 阅读短文, 理解其大意, 从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Years ago, I once worked as a volunteer teacher in a primary school in a small village. The school was old and small. I was a little 21. ________ by the environment. There was no gate, no playground and only one building with 22. ________ rooms—two of them for classrooms and one for the office, the other for cooking because some students ate their lunch at school.

23. ________ I was glad to be a Chinese teacher there. I 24. ________ the students of Grade Two. 25. ________ they were a little naughty(淘气的). They looked out of windows often and sometimes talked in class. Later, they had an interest in my class because I 26. ________ them lots of beautiful pictures. After class, I did outdoor activities with them. And I told them how rapidly our country was developing, and that they should study hard and make their hometown more 27. ________.

I did my best to 28. ________ them because I wanted to make a difference to their life. All the students were happy all the time. Soon I fell in love with this 29. ________.

Being a volunteer in the small village is a very special and unforgettable 30. ________ for me. I miss my students very much and I hope I can go there again some day.

questions.translation: 我对那里的环境感到有些惊讶。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“no gate, no playground...”简陋的环境让作者感到吃惊。故选 surprised。

questions.translation: 只有一幢带有四个房间的建筑……
questions.explanation: 后文列举“two of them for classrooms and one for the office, the other for cooking”（2+1+1=4间）。故选 four。

questions.translation: 然而，我很高兴在那里当一名语文老师。
questions.explanation: 环境简陋与很高兴去支教之间是转折关系，用However。故选 However。

questions.translation: 我教二年级的学生。
questions.explanation: 作者作为老师，教学生应用动词taught。故选 taught。

questions.translation: 起初，他们有点淘气。
questions.explanation: 与后文的“Later, they had an interest...”构成时间对比，对应At the beginning（起初）。故选 At the beginning。

questions.translation: 因为我给他们展示了许多漂亮的图片。
questions.explanation: show sb. sth. 表示向某人展示某物。故选 showed。

questions.translation: ……让他们把家乡建设得更加美丽。
questions.explanation: 鼓励学生努力学习把家乡建设得更美，用beautiful。故选 beautiful。

questions.translation: 我尽全力去教他们……
questions.explanation: 作者作为志愿者老师，竭尽全力教学，用teach。故选 teach。

questions.translation: 很快我便爱上了这个地方。
questions.explanation: 指代上文提到的这个小山村地方，用place。故选 place。

questions.translation: 对我来说是一段非常特别且难忘的回忆。
questions.explanation: 在村庄支教的经历是一段难忘的回忆，用memory。故选 memory。

sections.title: 七、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 三、语篇填空 阅读短文, 在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空, 使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage:
Let me tell you about my hometown—31. ________ town in Kinsale. It may be one of the smallest 32. ________ (town) in Southern Ireland, but it is also the most famous one.

The fish restaurants are very wonderful and there are many good 33. ________ (cook) here. They cook the best fish for the visitors. People enjoy the food very much 34. ________ it's delicious. So you can see many people from different countries in every restaurant.

My hometown is very beautiful because it is by the sea. In summer, it is very cool and you can swim 35. ________ (happy) in the sea. There 36. ________ (be) three small shops and you can buy your friends many souvenirs(纪念品) there. They are not expensive and you can pay a little money 37. ________ them.

The people in my town are 38. ________ (friend). They can make friends with you. If you 39. ________ (feel) sick, there is a clinic(诊所) with a doctor and a nurse. You can ask 40. ________ (they) for help when you have some trouble.

questions.prompt: 31. ...—______ town in Kinsale.
questions.translation: ——金赛尔的一个小镇。
questions.explanation: 泛指一个城镇，town首音标为辅音，用不定冠词a。故选 a。

questions.prompt: 32. ...one of the smallest ______ (town)...
questions.translation: 爱尔兰南部最小的城镇之一……
questions.explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，用towns。故选 towns。

questions.prompt: 33. ...many good ______ (cook) here.
questions.translation: 这里有许多优秀的厨师。
questions.explanation: cook作为名词表示厨师，many修饰复数名词cooks（注意cooker是炊具）。故选 cooks。

questions.prompt: 34. People enjoy the food very much ______ it's delicious.
questions.translation: 人们非常喜欢这里的食物，因为它们很美味。
questions.explanation: 前后句为因果关系，后句解释原因，用连词because。故选 because。

questions.prompt: 35. ...you can swim ______ (happy) in the sea.
questions.translation: 你可以在海里开心地游泳。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词swim用副词happily。故选 happily。

questions.prompt: 36. There ______ (be) three small shops...
questions.translation: 那里有三家小商店……
questions.explanation: there be句型遵循就近原则，主语three small shops为复数，一般现在时用are。故选 are。

questions.prompt: 37. ...pay a little money ______ them.
questions.translation: 你可以花很少的钱买下它们。
questions.explanation: pay money for sth.为固定搭配，意为“付钱买某物”。故选 for。

questions.prompt: 38. The people in my town are ______ (friend).
questions.translation: 我们镇上的人们很友好。
questions.explanation: be动词are后接形容词friendly作表语。故选 friendly。

questions.prompt: 39. If you ______ (feel) sick...
questions.translation: 如果你感觉不适……
questions.explanation: if条件状语从句主语为you，谓语动词用原形feel。故选 feel。

questions.prompt: 40. You can ask ______ (they) for help...
questions.translation: 你可以向他们求助……
questions.explanation: 动词ask后接人称代词宾格them（ask sb. for help）。故选 them。

sections.title: 八、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 四、阅读与表达 阅读短文, 然后根据内容选择最佳答案或回答问题。
sections.passage:
On a small farm in Mexico, there are no schools. A bus is the school. The driver of the bus is the teacher. It's a school bus, but it doesn't take the children to school. It just goes round from place to place, and sometimes it comes to this farm in June. The bus will stay here and teach the children. The farmers call it a school on wheels (轮子). Every time when the bus comes, the farmers will come, running to it, shouting and laughing. They warmly welcome the school bus. All the people on the farm like the school bus very much.

When the bus is on the farm, in the morning, the teacher teaches the small children. In the afternoon, the bigger children come to have their lessons because they must work in the morning. At night, the fathers and mothers come to school. They want to learn too. People on the farm all want to learn knowledge, but they don't have a school on the farm. In September, the bus will leave for another farm.

How the farmers hope that some day they can have a real school on their farm!

questions.prompt: 41. Who teaches the children on the bus school?
questions.translation: 谁在公交车学校上教孩子们？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“The driver of the bus is the teacher.”可知是公交车司机。故选 The driver of the bus.。

questions.prompt: 42. What will the bus school do when it comes to this farm?
options: It will stay here and teach the children.
It will take the farmers to the big city.
It will sell books and food to people.
It will repair all the old farm trucks.
questions.translation: 公交车学校来到农场时会做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“The bus will stay here and teach the children.”可知留在这里给孩子们上课。故选 It will stay here and teach the children.。

questions.prompt: 43. Why do the farmers call it a school on wheels?
options: Because it has many toy wheels.
Because the farmers like playing wheels.
Because the classroom is round like a wheel.
questions.translation: 为什么农民们称它为车轮上的学校？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段内容，因为学校设在一辆可以开走的公交车里。故选 Because it's a bus school.。

questions.prompt: 44. What do you think of the school? (30 words or more)
options: I think the bus school is very helpful and meaningful for the farmers and children because it brings knowledge and hope to people who don't have a real school.
I think the bus school is too small and noisy so nobody wants to study in it.
I don't think it is good because it should stay in the city all year round.
I think farmers should not learn knowledge at night.
questions.translation: 你觉得这所学校怎么样？（30词或更多）
questions.explanation: 选项A客观评价了公交车学校为偏远农场带来知识和希望的积极意义，符合题意与字数要求。故选A。
